# Spec: Ask a question about your own text

[Specs](README.md) | [User guide](../user-guide/ask-your-own-documents.md)

**Start:** `/ai/rag`  
**Persona:** A developer learning retrieval augmented generation  
**Goal:** Give the model a few passages, ask a question, and see which passages the answer came from.

**Table 1 — Acceptance criteria**

| Step | Action | Expected result |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | Review the passages and the question | The Ask button is enabled. |
| 2 | Ask | An answer is shown.<br>The sources table lists the passages used, closest first. |
